name: Nihongo Master v1.4.0 - 3D Katakana Cards
changelog: v1.4.0: Added complete 3D Katakana Cards game mode powered by Godot 4 and Blender 3D! Includes authentic 8-stage, 3-set progressive Katakana vocabulary curriculum (~137 loanwords), targeted decoy kana pools (Gojūon, Dakuten, Handakuten, Chōonpu ー, Sokuon ッ, and confusable pairs like シ/ツ and ソ/ン), updated 4-game Title Screen, and dedicated Stage Select screen.
